::: {#def-mse}
#### Mean squared error

The **population mean squared error (pMSE)** of an estimator $\hparam$,
also called its **mean squared error** or its **expected squared estimation error (ESEE)**, denoted
$\pMSE{\hparam}$ or $\ESEE{\hparam}$, is the expectation of the square
of the [estimation error](#def-estimation-error) [@wikipedia_mean_squared_error]:

$$\pMSE{\hparam} \eqdef \E{\sqf{\erf{\hparam}}}$$

Source: @wikipedia_mean_squared_error.
:::
